front_question: State the Laws of Reflection and Snell's Law of Refraction.
back_answer: Laws of Reflection: 1. Angle of incidence equals angle of reflection (i = r). 2. Incident ray, reflected ray, and normal at the point of incidence lie in the same plane. Snell's Law of Refraction: For a given pair of media and light wavelength, the ratio of sine of angle of incidence to sine of angle of refraction is constant: sin(i) / sin(r) = refractive index (n21).

front_question: State the Mirror Formula, Lens Formula, and Magnification formulas.
back_answer: Mirror Formula: 1/v + 1/u = 1/f. Mirror Magnification: m = h'/h = -v/u. Lens Formula: 1/v - 1/u = 1/f. Lens Magnification: m = h'/h = +v/u. Power of Lens: P = 1 / f(in meters) [SI unit: Dioptre (D)].

front_question: State the New Cartesian Sign Convention rules for spherical mirrors and lenses.
back_answer: 1. Object is placed to the left; incident light travels left to right. 2. Distances measured right of origin (+x axis) are positive; distances left (-x axis) are negative (object distance u is always negative). 3. Distances above principal axis (+y) are positive; below (-y) are negative. 4. Focal length f is negative for concave mirrors/lenses and positive for convex mirrors/lenses.

front_question: Describe refraction of light through a rectangular glass slab and lateral displacement (Activity 9.10).
back_answer: When a ray enters glass slab from air, it refracts towards the normal (denser glass). When exiting glass to air, it refracts away from normal. The emergent ray is parallel to the incident ray but laterally shifted/displaced because the extent of bending at both parallel faces is equal and opposite (Angle i = Angle e).

front_question: An object 5 cm tall is placed 25 cm away from a convex lens of focal length 10 cm. Find the image position, height, and nature.
back_answer: Given: u = -25 cm, f = +10 cm, h = +5 cm. Lens Formula: 1/v - 1/u = 1/f => 1/v = 1/10 + 1/(-25) = (5-2)/50 = 3/50 => v = +16.67 cm (behind lens). Magnification m = v/u = 16.67 / (-25) = -0.667. Height h' = m x h = -0.667 x 5 = -3.33 cm. Nature: Real, inverted, diminished image.
